mainEntity.name: When is the Astore markhor hunting season?

acceptedAnswer.text: The legal hunting period is 15 October to 30 April. We recommend mid November to mid February.

mainEntity.name: How are trophy hunting permits allocated in Pakistan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permits are allocated to Pakistani outfitters through an open government auction. Our rates are based on the season's permit fees; minor increases are absorbed by Hunt Venture Safaris, and a substantial rise is communicated and invoiced separately.

mainEntity.name: What happens if the Islamabad to Gilgit flight is cancelled?

acceptedAnswer.text: Return flights between Islamabad and Gilgit are included, and 4x4 road transport is provided if flights are cancelled.
